title: The owner's 2026-09-30 parks are on their rows: the ten iOS readiness rows wait for the native app, and 24 P3 rows wait until after launch, each with its revisit trigger

source.ref: owner multiple choice 2026-09-30 ~01:45Z (the iOS readiness rows) and the P3 sort approved ~01:50Z; companion to HYG-156, split off for the PR size gate

detail:
FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-30. The companion of HYG-156, which records the same day's rulings on the owner rows; the two were split so each PR stays under the size gate. This row records two rounds as edit fragments (ADR-1635), with the consequence in ADR-1682. No code changes.

1. ~01:45Z, "Park with the native app": LIVE-714, LIVE-716, LIVE-717, LIVE-718, LIVE-719, LIVE-720, LIVE-721, LIVE-722, LIVE-723 and LIVE-726 are parked. REVISIT TRIGGER: reopen together when the native Expo/React Native app build (DEF-MOBILE, itself parked to 2027-01-05) is started. LIVE-713, LIVE-715 (done), LIVE-724 (done) and OWN-092 (done) are unaffected. DEF-MOBILE's notes and detail name the ten.
2. ~01:50Z, the P3 sort, park until after launch: PROG-GD6, LIVE-693, LIVE-664, LIVE-665, LIVE-667, LIVE-708, LIVE-671, LIVE-673, LIVE-663, LIVE-682, LIVE-669, LIVE-668, LIVE-676, LIVE-677, LIVE-675, LIVE-679, LIVE-678, LIVE-690, LIVE-691, LIVE-662, LIVE-658, LIVE-710, LIVE-692 and LIVE-695. REVISIT TRIGGER: reopen after launch (2026-12-21), on the first real paid order or the first six weeks of live Spaces, whichever comes first. The same sort's drop of LIVE-659 is recorded by HYG-156. Left for their own PRs and untouched here: LIVE-656, LIVE-709, LIVE-696, HYG-139, LIVE-681, LIVE-666, LIVE-684, LIVE-689, LIVE-660, LIVE-674, LIVE-655 and LIVE-672.

HOW. Each parked row carries parkedUntil and its trigger in notes, keeps its probe (parked rows are not probed), and leaves its wave by itself. HYG-146's done probe held the ten iOS rows active and would read as regressed, so it is amended in the same change because the ruling changes what its done means: the ten move to its held list, and a parked row whose notes cite ADR-1682 (PROG-GD6's phone door and LIVE-671 match its mobile-title pattern) counts as ruled. HYG-138's hold on PROG-GD6 is amended by HYG-156, which accepts a row whose notes name a ruling or sort dated 2026-09-30; until it merges HYG-138 reads the base file, where PROG-GD6 is still open.

CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1682). The probe reads the merged view and fails on main (bef0a6edf), where all 34 are open.

verify.cmd: node -e 'let d;try{d=require("./scripts/lib/ledger.mjs").loadBacklog(".")}catch(e){console.error(String(e));process.exit(79)}const by=new Map(d.entries.map((e)=>[e.id,e]));const bad=[];const parked=(e,trig)=>e.status==="parked"&&/parkedUntil/.test(e.notes||"")&&/ADR-1682/.test(e.notes||"")&&trig.test(e.notes||"")&&/REVISIT TRIGGER/.test(e.detail||"");const want=(what,trig,ids)=>{for(const id of ids){const e=by.get(id);if(!e)bad.push(id+" is gone");else if(!parked(e,trig))bad.push(id+" is "+e.status+", the 2026-09-30 ruling says "+what)}};want("parked with the native app",/native app build/,["LIVE-714","LIVE-716","LIVE-717","LIVE-718","LIVE-719","LIVE-720","LIVE-721","LIVE-722","LIVE-723","LIVE-726"]);want("parked until after launch",/after launch/,["PROG-GD6","LIVE-693","LIVE-664","LIVE-665","LIVE-667","LIVE-708","LIVE-671","LIVE-673","LIVE-663","LIVE-682","LIVE-669","LIVE-668","LIVE-676","LIVE-677","LIVE-675","LIVE-679","LIVE-678","LIVE-690","LIVE-691","LIVE-662","LIVE-658","LIVE-710","LIVE-692","LIVE-695"]);const dm=by.get("DEF-MOBILE");if(!dm||dm.status!=="parked"||!/LIVE-726/.test(dm.notes||""))bad.push("DEF-MOBILE is not parked naming the ten readiness rows");if(bad.length){console.error("HYG-157: "+bad.join("; "));process.exit(1)}console.log("ok: 10 iOS readiness rows parked with the native app, 24 P3 rows parked until after launch, each with parkedUntil and its trigger")'
verify.note: Reads the merged ledger view (ADR-1635) in-process: the ten iOS readiness rows are parked with a parkedUntil note naming the native app build, the 24 P3 rows are parked with a parkedUntil note naming after launch, every one cites ADR-1682 in its notes and carries a REVISIT TRIGGER in its detail, and DEF-MOBILE is parked naming the ten. Fails on main at bef0a6edf, where all 34 are open. About 160 ms CPU.
